channel.title: Worth the Fee
channel.description: Straight answers on whether a travel card or program is worth it for you.

item.title: Rakuten Temu cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?
item.description: Yes: 2% on November 24, 2026, on orders up to a $250 cart. Temu app orders, phones, tablets, laptops and carts filled before the click are excluded.

item.title: Rakuten Costco cash back: does it work, and what works instead?
item.description: No. On November 24, 2026, Rakuten's Costco page showed coupons only, with no cash back. Costco's own 2% Reward and card rewards still apply.

item.title: Rakuten Apple cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?
item.description: Rakuten Apple cash back was 2% on November 24, 2026, only on accessories, refurbished items, AppleCare+ and Beats. New iPhones and Macs earn nothing.

item.title: Rakuten Macy's cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?
item.description: Rakuten Macy's cash back was 10% on November 24, 2026 (usual 2%), with 1.5% on furniture, electronics and marketplace items. No gift cards.

item.title: Rakuten Best Buy cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?
item.description: Rakuten Best Buy cash back was up to 8% by category on November 24, 2026; most items earn 1%. Apple, game consoles and gift cards earn nothing.

item.title: Rakuten Sam's Club cash back: what earns 9%, what earns 3%, and what is excluded?
item.description: Yes. On November 24, 2026: 9% on new memberships (usual 4%) and 3% on eligible items (usual 1%). Groceries, renewals and Scan & Go earn nothing.

item.title: Rakuten Walmart cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?
item.description: Rakuten works with Walmart as a flat $5 on up to three orders of $25 or more, not a percentage. Groceries, pharmacy and app orders are excluded.

item.title: Rakuten Lululemon cash back: does it work, and what works instead?
item.description: Not on November 24, 2026: Rakuten's lululemon page read "No Cash Back". Lululemon eGift cards from Giftcards.com showed 3% the same day.

item.title: Rakuten PetSmart cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?
item.description: Yes: 10% on November 24, 2026 (usual rate 2%). Pharmacy items, vet care, gift cards and repeat Autoship orders are excluded.

item.title: Rakuten Etsy cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?
item.description: Yes: 1% on November 24, 2026, with no category tiers. Gift cards and shipping labels bought by Etsy sellers are the only exclusions listed.

item.title: Rakuten Ulta cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?
item.description: Rakuten Ulta cash back was 2% on November 24, 2026. Dior, Marketplace items, gift cards and anything paid with Ulta rewards earn nothing.

item.title: Rakuten Dyson cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?
item.description: Yes: 10% online on November 24, 2026 (usual rate 1%), and 1% in store. Refurbished machines, parts and accessories are excluded.

item.title: Rakuten Kohl's cash back: does it work, and does it stack with Kohl's Cash?
item.description: Rakuten Kohl's cash back was 2% on November 24, 2026. The part of an order paid with Kohl's Cash earns nothing; earning Kohl's Cash is not confirmed.

item.title: Rakuten Target cash back: does it work, and what is excluded?
item.description: Rakuten Target cash back was 1% on November 24, 2026, in listed categories only. Grocery, electronics, toys, gift cards and Drive Up earn nothing.

item.title: Is Rakuten free, and what is the catch?
item.description: Yes. Rakuten has no membership fee and no fee to shop. The costs are your shopping data, a wait of months for payment, and a $5 minimum.

item.title: Rakuten welcome bonus or a friend's referral bonus: which one do you get, and which is bigger?
item.description: On November 24, 2026 Rakuten's own pages showed a $10 welcome bonus and a member's link showed $50 after $50 of purchases. You get one, not both.

item.title: Rakuten cash back rates today, by store (November 24)
item.description: The headline Rakuten cash back rate at 70 large stores, read from Rakuten's store pages on November 24, 2026, with what changed since the last reading.

item.title: Forgot to activate Rakuten before buying: can you still get the cash back?
item.description: Usually not. Rakuten says a purchase earns only if it starts from a Rakuten link. A new order started through Rakuten can earn.

item.title: Can you stack Rakuten cash back with credit card points and store coupons?
item.description: Yes, you can stack Rakuten with credit card rewards; they are separate. Coupons often work, but a code not listed on Rakuten can void cash back.

item.title: How does Rakuten in-store cash back work, and which cards can you link?
item.description: Link a Visa, Mastercard or Amex card, add the store's offer before you shop, then pay in the store with that card. No receipt upload.

item.title: Rakuten on Black Friday 2026: how cash back works and which rates are raised
item.description: Rakuten works on Black Friday as on any day, but store rates move daily. Activate before filling the cart; payment comes in February or May 2027.

item.title: Rakuten sign-up bonus: how the bonus from a friend's link works and what makes it fail
item.description: The Rakuten sign-up bonus from a friend's link needs $50 of purchases that earn cash back within 90 days. It is paid on the next payment date.

item.title: How does Rakuten work, step by step?
item.description: You click through Rakuten to a store and buy. The store pays Rakuten a commission, and Rakuten passes part of it to you four times a year.

item.title: What does Rakuten do for Cyber Monday 2026, and how is it different from Black Friday?
item.description: Cyber Monday is November 30, 2026. Rakuten lists raised store rates, but none for the day itself has been published. Earning works as on any day.

item.title: Chase Sapphire Preferred hotel credit: how it works and what bookings count
item.description: The Chase Sapphire Preferred hotel credit is up to $100 per account year, up from $50 in June 2026, for prepaid stays booked through Chase Travel.

item.title: What does Amex Platinum cell phone protection cover, and what is the deductible?
item.description: Amex Platinum covers a stolen or damaged phone up to $800 per claim after a $50 deductible, twice a year, if the phone bill is paid with the card.

item.title: Amex Platinum and golf: does the card do anything for golfers?
item.description: The US American Express Platinum has no free rounds, green fee credit or tee time priority. Its hotel credit and lounges can help a golf trip.

item.title: Rakuten order not showing up or cash back missing: what causes it and how do you claim it?
item.description: If a Rakuten order is not showing after 48 hours, check the store's exclusions, then file the Missing Cash Back form within 90 days.

item.title: When does Rakuten pay you, and when is the next payout?
item.description: Rakuten pays on February 15, May 15, August 15 and November 15. The next payout is February 15, 2027, if you have about $5 confirmed.

item.title: Do premium credit cards offer golf travel packages as well as tee-time bookings?
item.description: Mostly tee-time help. Amex Platinum and Sapphire Reserve list no packaged golf trips; Mastercard's Priceless site lists some, sold by a tour operator.
